description: Switch OpenViking's embedding model to a local llama-server (or any OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint) running inside a bwrap sandbox managed by job-env-manager. Handles the full lifecycle: detect current config, validate the target embedding endpoint, modify ov.conf, delete incompatible vectordb index when dimension changes, restart the openviking-server process in the sandbox, and verify the new collection dimension. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) switch the OpenViking embedding model, (2) change the embedding dimension, (3) fix EmbeddingRebuildRequiredError after a dimension mismatch, (4) rebuild the vectordb index after an embedding model change, (5) use a local llama-server for OpenViking embeddings. Trigger words: "切换OpenViking embedding", "OpenViking embedding模型", "OpenViking向量化模型", "openviking embedding switch", "change openviking embedding model", "配置openviking embedding", "openviking llama embedding", "bge embedding openviking", "切换向量化模型", "OpenViking模型切换".
